lines.p1: The traditional way: plan everything up front, then build, test and deliver.
lines.p2: Months pass before anyone sees working software.
lines.p3: Meanwhile requirements change, and the customer only reacts at the very end.
lines.p4: The later we find a mistake, the more it costs to fix.
lines.p5: And software work is complex: we cannot predict everything in advance.
lines.s1: Scrum replaces one big bet with many small ones.
lines.s2: Build a little, show it, learn, and adjust.
lines.outro: Plan a little. Learn a lot.
